lines.speaker: annex_staffer
lines.text: Every member declares their interests. The declarations are public. Nobody has read one since the register went digital and the digital one only goes back to 2058.

lines.speaker: annex_staffer
lines.text: The paper register goes back to 2031 and it is in the chamber cloakroom, which is not somewhere a staffer can go. Cross-check it against tonight's signatories and I will know exactly who I have been working for.

choices.text: We can get into the cloakroom.
